zh.groupedLead: 终端会将同一种武器或饰品聚合显示在同一格中。左下角的数字是该组装备的总数。
zh.groupedP1: 若同组装备有不同词条，格子右下角会出现加号。空手单击加号，或右击该格，即可展开。
zh.groupedP2: 展开后，相同词条的装备各占一格，无词条的装备也单独列出。各格按重铸价格从高到低排列。将鼠标移到对应格子上可查看属性，单击即可取出。再次单击原格的加号或右击原格，即可收起。
zh.title: 终端指南
zh.controlLead: 总控卡可从 AE 终端打开《更好的体验》的总控面板。
zh.controlP1: 安装总控卡后，点击终端左栏的总控面板图标。选择功能项即可进入对应界面。灰色条目表示该功能当前不可用。
zh.controlP2: 从总控面板打开子菜单后，退出子菜单即可返回 AE 主终端。
zh.installLead: 终端右上方有四个通用升级卡槽，每个槽位可安装一张卡。
zh.installP1: 启用卡机制时，安装微光卡可使用微光转化。重铸卡解锁随机重铸，重铸升级卡单独安装即可随机重铸和自选词缀。磁卡提供拾取功能。同种卡只能安装一张。取下卡后，对应功能随之关闭。
zh.installP2: 在模组的通用配置中关闭「启用卡机制」，即可使用全部升级功能，无需安装卡片。
zh.magnetLead: 磁卡控制掉落物的吸引与拾取。安装磁卡后，从终端左栏打开「磁卡设置」。
zh.magnetP1: 开启磁力可吸引附近的掉落物。磁力开关与拾取方式可以分别设置。
zh.magnetP2:
直接存入终端：拾取的物品优先进入终端。
背包优先：先填充背包，剩余物品存入终端。
同类物品入库：若终端已有该类物品，新拾取的同类物品直接入库。其余物品按通常方式拾取。钱币不参与同类匹配。
zh.reforgeLead: 重铸卡解锁终端的随机重铸。
zh.reforgeP1: 将可重铸的物品放入重铸栏，查看当前报价，再点击锤子。每次重铸都会支付一次费用，并重新抽取词缀。
zh.reforgeP2: 需要指定词缀时，可将普通重铸卡升级成重铸升级卡。
zh.orderLead: 在 JEI 物品列表或左侧收藏栏中，用鼠标中键点击要制作的物品。输入所需成品数量，进入合成计划。
zh.orderP1: 终端先使用已有材料。缺少的中间产物若有可用配方，会列入同一份订单。终端按配方的整批产量制作。
zh.orderP2: 材料和工作站齐备后，点击「开始」，整份订单会瞬间完成合成，包括所有中间步骤。成品默认进入终端库存。开启「下单产品直达背包」后，背包装不下的部分仍会入库。「置顶自动合成得到的物品」可将新入库的成品显示在库存顶部。
zh.orderP3: 在 JEI 左侧收藏栏中，逐项取消同一订单的缺失材料收藏时，取消最后一项会同步取消这笔订单。要一次取消整组，将鼠标移到组内任一材料上，按住 Shift 再按收藏键。
zh.planLead: 确认页列出已有材料、需要合成的数量和缺口。点击树状图标打开配方树，可以沿成品向下查看每一步所需的材料和数量。
zh.planP1: 点击「收藏缺失」会将缺失的物品加入 JEI 左侧收藏栏，并停留在当前界面。收藏栏按「已有数量 / 所需数量」显示材料进度。终端可使用库存和背包里的材料；开启「允许调用已装备物品」后，已装备的功能物品也可作为材料。标为收藏的物品受到保护。
zh.planP2: 计划顶部会列出缺少的工作方块。将对应工作站放入终端的工作方块栏，或在游戏中靠近该工作站，再查看计划。兼容的多合一工作方块可以同时提供多种工作站功能。
zh.shimmerLead: 将微光卡装入升级槽，即可使用终端的微光栏。
zh.shimmerP1: 将物品放入左侧输入格，点击下方的微光图标。可转化的物品会变为对应产物，可分解的物品则按配方返还材料。
zh.shimmerP2: 数量不足一批的材料留在输入格。点击右侧产物格可以逐格取出，也可以用转移按钮将产物送入终端库存或背包。
zh.reforgeUpgradeLead: 重铸升级卡同时提供随机重铸与自选词缀。
zh.reforgeUpgradeP1: 将物品放入重铸栏，点击锤子查看可用词缀。列表按应用词缀后的报价排序；选定词缀后，支付当前物品的一次重铸费用。
zh.reforgeUpgradeP2: 按住 Shift 点击锤子，即可按当前报价随机重铸。
zh.overviewLead: AE: Beyond Dimensions 将物品存储与自动合成整合到一个终端中。放置 ME 控制器并右键激活，即可为当前角色解锁终端。此后按下终端快捷键，便可随时存取物品、查看库存和提交合成订单。终端开启期间，角色无法移动、使用钩爪或骑乘坐骑。关闭终端后即可恢复操作。
zh.overviewP1: 终端库存会随物品存入自动扩容，无需安装存储元件。在日常游玩中，存储容量几乎没有上限，实际容量取决于可用内存和角色存档大小。同类物品会在终端中合并显示，方便查看库存总量。
zh.overviewP2: 终端无需合成 CPU 即可计算合成计划。提交订单前，可在计划中查看所需材料、中间产物与缺少的工作站。材料和工作站齐备后，确认订单即可瞬间完成全部合成步骤。

en.groupedLead: The terminal groups weapons or accessories of the same type in one slot. The count in the lower left shows the total for the group.
en.groupedP1: A plus sign appears in the lower right when items in the group have different modifiers. With an empty cursor, click the plus sign or right-click the slot to expand it.
en.groupedP2: Each modifier has its own slot, including a separate slot for unmodified items. Slots are ordered by reforge price, highest first. Hover over a slot to inspect its items and click to take one. Click the plus sign or right-click the original slot again to collapse the group.
en.title: Terminal Guide
en.controlLead: Access the Quality of Terraria control panel from the AE terminal.
en.controlP1: Install the card and select the control panel icon in the left sidebar. Select a function to open it. Gray entries are currently unavailable.
en.controlP2: Close a submenu opened from the control panel to return to the main AE terminal.
en.installLead: The terminal has four upgrade slots in the upper right. Each holds one card.
en.installP1: When upgrade cards are required, install a Shimmer Card for shimmer transmutation. A Reforge Card unlocks random reforging. A Reforge Upgrade Card alone unlocks both random reforging and prefix selection. The Magnet Card enables pickup upgrades. You can install one of each type. Removing a card disables its upgrade.
en.installP2: Turn off Require upgrade cards in the mod's General Settings to use all upgrades without installing cards.
en.magnetLead: The Magnet Card controls item attraction and pickup. Install the card, then open Magnet Settings from the terminal's left sidebar.
en.magnetP1: Enable attraction to draw nearby drops toward you. The attraction switch and the pickup mode work independently.
en.magnetP2:
Terminal first: send pickups directly to storage.
Inventory first: fill your inventory and send the remainder to storage.
Matching items: send pickups to storage if it already contains that item type. Other items follow normal pickup rules. Coins are excluded from matching.
en.reforgeLead: The Reforge Card unlocks random reforging at the terminal.
en.reforgeP1: Place a reforgeable item in the reforge slot and check the quoted price. Click the hammer to pay that price and roll a prefix.
en.reforgeP2: To select a specific prefix, upgrade the Reforge Card to a Reforge Upgrade Card.
en.orderLead: Middle-click the item you want in the JEI item list or in your bookmarks on the left. Enter the number of finished items you want, then open the crafting plan.
en.orderP1: The terminal uses available ingredients first. If a missing component has a usable recipe, the terminal adds it to the same order. The terminal crafts in whole batches.
en.orderP2: Once the materials and crafting stations are available, select Start. The entire order crafts instantly, including all intermediate steps. Finished items go into terminal storage. You can send them to your inventory instead; overflow goes into storage. Enable pinning in Terminal Settings to show newly stored products at the top.
en.orderP3: In the JEI bookmarks on the left, removing the last missing ingredient from an order also cancels that order. To cancel the whole group at once, hover over any ingredient in the group, hold Shift, and press the bookmark key.
en.planLead: The plan lists the amounts in storage, the amounts to craft, and any shortages. Select the tree icon to open the crafting tree. Follow a branch down from the finished item to see the ingredients for each step.
en.planP1: Select Bookmark Missing to add missing ingredients to the JEI bookmarks and stay on the current screen. Each bookmark shows the available quantity followed by the required quantity. The terminal draws from storage and your inventory. You can also allow functional equipment to be used as ingredients. Favorited items are protected.
en.planP2: Missing stations appear at the top of the plan. Place the station in a terminal station slot, or stand near it in game, then check the plan again. A compatible combined station can supply several station types at once.
en.shimmerLead: Install a Shimmer Card to unlock the shimmer tab.
en.shimmerP1: Place an item in the input slot on the left and click the shimmer icon below it. Transmutation changes an item into its counterpart. Decrafting returns materials from its recipe.
en.shimmerP2: Any items left over after processing whole batches stay in the input slot. Click a result to pick it up, or use the transfer buttons to send the results to terminal storage or your inventory.
en.reforgeUpgradeLead: The Reforge Upgrade Card provides random reforging and prefix selection.
en.reforgeUpgradeP1: Place an item in the reforge slot and click the hammer to view its available prefixes. The list is sorted by the resulting reforge price. Choosing a prefix costs one reforge at the current item’s quoted price.
en.reforgeUpgradeP2: Hold Shift and click the hammer to roll a random prefix at the current price.
en.overviewLead: AE: Beyond Dimensions brings item storage and autocrafting together in one terminal. Place an ME Controller and right-click it to unlock the terminal for your character. You can then use the terminal hotkey to deposit and withdraw items, check your stock, and place crafting orders. While the terminal is open, movement, grappling hooks, and mounting are disabled. Close the terminal to use them again.
en.overviewP1: Storage expands as you deposit items. No storage cells are required. In everyday play, capacity is virtually unlimited. Its practical limits depend on available memory and character save size. The terminal groups items of the same type and displays their total count.
en.overviewP2: The terminal calculates crafting plans without a crafting CPU. Before placing an order, review the required materials, intermediate products, and missing crafting stations. Once the materials and stations are available, confirm the order to complete every crafting step instantly.
